modifiers.name: Blood Moon
modifiers.description: The moon rides low and red. Every fare pays a fifth more, and the night deals one rule deeper.

modifiers.name: Hungry City
modifiers.description: Dispatch wants more than the night is worth. The quota rises by a quarter.

modifiers.name: Rationed Pumps
modifiers.description: The depots are dry until dawn. You start thirty points down, and desperate fares tip better.

modifiers.name: Dead Frequency
modifiers.description: The radio picks up voices between stations. Fares run a tenth light, but the night is thick with lore.

modifiers.name: Witching Hour
modifiers.description: The streets empty of the living. The quota eases, but what remains out there runs a rule deeper.

modifiers.name: Gilded Dusk
modifiers.description: Money moves tonight, and dispatch knows it. Fares and quota both climb by a third.
